definitions.explanation: Attached to a noun to mean getting away from it or doing without it: {脱炭素|だつたんそ} "decarbonization," {脱|だつ}サラ "quitting salaried work."

examples.japanese: ⟦{脱炭素|だつたんそ}→脱炭素：06410_datsutanso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脱|だつ}サラ→脱サラ：29183_datsusara⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦パン{屋|や}→パン屋：19415_panya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: He quit his office job and opened a bakery.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{脱原発|だつげんぱつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Many countries continue to debate whether to phase out nuclear power.

notes:
Common in news and slogans, and productive: new {脱|だつ}〜 words appear often.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{脱炭素|だつたんそ}→脱炭素：06410_datsutanso⟧: decarbonization
- {脱原発|だつげんぱつ}: phasing out nuclear power
- ⟦{脱|だつ}サラ→脱サラ：29183_datsusara⟧: leaving a salaried job to go independent
- {脱|だつ}マンネリ: breaking out of a rut
- ⟦{脱毛|だつもう}→脱毛：24914_datsumou⟧: hair removal (a word of its own)
